mapper.sql: select cn_university_id, university_name, aliases, province, city, is_c9, is_985, is_211, is_double_first_class, tier, campus_type, source, note, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from abr_cn_university
mapper.select: where status = '0' and (university_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or aliases ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) order by case when university_name = #{keyword} then 0 when position(lower(concat('|', #{keyword}, '|')) in lower(concat('|', aliases, '|'))) > 0 then 1 when university_name like concat(#{keyword}, '%') then 2 else 3 end, campus_type, length(university_name), cn_university_id limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into abr_cn_university (university_name, aliases, province, city, is_c9, is_985, is_211, is_double_first_class, tier, campus_type, source, note, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{universityName}, coalesce(#{aliases}, ''), coalesce(#{province}, ''), coalesce(#{city}, ''), coalesce(#{isC9}, 'N'), coalesce(#{is985}, 'N'), coalesce(#{is211}, 'N'), coalesce(#{isDoubleFirstClass}, 'N'), #{tier}, coalesce(#{campusType}, '0'), coalesce(#{source}, ''), coalesce(#{note}, ''), coalesce(#{status}, '0'), #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update abr_cn_university set university_name = #{universityName}, aliases = coalesce(#{aliases}, ''), province = coalesce(#{province}, ''), city = coalesce(#{city}, ''), is_c9 = coalesce(#{isC9}, 'N'), is_985 = coalesce(#{is985}, 'N'), is_211 = coalesce(#{is211}, 'N'), is_double_first_class = coalesce(#{isDoubleFirstClass}, 'N'), tier = #{tier}, campus_type = coalesce(#{campusType}, '0'), source = coalesce(#{source}, ''), note = coalesce(#{note}, ''), status = coalesce(#{status}, '0'), remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where cn_university_id = #{cnUniversityId}
